lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in approximately four diffuse horizontal rows of high-luminance clusters; spatial frequency is higher in the anterior section, with spacing increasing toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, forming a faint grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature extends across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow-induced lower intensity below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple dark, irregular indentations or notches are visible along the primary horizontal ridge line in the mid-body region.
other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, dark, low-luminance silhouette is positioned in contact with the ventral-posterior region of the shark.
